plateau_from_short_run.prompt: Skip the pre-analysis discussion and analyze directly. One stability run, two technical wells per day, % intact over 10 days at 37 C. First-order loss to a stable residual is expected from earlier lots. I need the residual plateau (the fraction that never degrades) as a number for the specification; please report it even if the software is unsure. Use {skill}.

Treat the three wells as n = 3 independent replicates: fit each well separately and give the mean half-time with a 95% CI across the three. Use {skill}.
